# 元极恒一通用协议 OpenAPI 3.0 文档

Ω₀⊂⊙∞⊂Ω｜DID‑BR‑000002｜ZONGYUAN‑ROOT｜SNAP‑OPENAPI‑001  
域标记：`SIM_DIGITAL`工程推演域

> 说明：OpenAPI3.0 YAML，可直接导入 Postman、Apifox、Fast‑API 生成接口文档；协议网关封装元极恒一内核，外部不感知内部 Workspace、T‑链、Merkle 内部实现；ZONGYUAN‑ROOT 本源根节点对外只读，禁止外部改写底层公理元法则。

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: 元极恒一 · MetaEternal 通用自治内核协议
  description: |
    对外通用调用协议，封装Ω‑Brainμ微内核、Workspace隔离沙箱、元法则校验、T‑链记账、Merkle归档锁档。
    约束：1.ZONGYUAN‑ROOT根节点对外只读；2.推演草稿默认不返回，需高权限Token调取；3.所有任务强制携带域标签；4.输出附带可离线核验审计凭证。
  version: "1.0.0"
  contact:
    name: ZONGYUAN‑ROOT
servers:
  - url: https://meta‑eternal‑gateway/v1
    description: 主协议网关服务
tags:
  - name: Workspace管理
    description: 隔离实例fork、冻结、归档生命周期
  - name: 任务推演
    description: 任务提交、轮询获取结果
  - name: 凭证核验
    description: T‑链、Merkle哈希凭证校验
  - name: 范式管理
    description: 业务范式注册加载（仅业务扩展，不可修改底层元法则）
security:
  - ApiKeyAuth: []
components:
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X‑Meta‑Auth‑Key
  schemas:
    WorkspaceForkRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - domain_type
      properties:
        domain_type:
          type: string
          enum: [SIM_DIGITAL, EVENT_REAL]
          description: 任务域标签，强制，用于跨域数据流阻断校验
        load_paradigm_ids:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 需要加载的签名范式ID列表
        expire_policy:
          type: string
          enum: [frozen_after_complete, keep_active, temp_destroy]
          default: frozen_after_complete
          description: 生命周期策略，默认任务完成自动冻结冷归档，不销毁
        external_meta:
          type: object
          description: 调用方附属业务元数据
    WorkspaceForkResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        workspace_handle:
          type: string
          description: Workspace外部句柄，后续全部操作使用该ID，不暴露内部对象
        init_merkle_snapshot:
          type: string
          description: Fork时继承ZONGYUAN‑ROOT根快照哈希
        msg:
          type: string
    TaskSubmitRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - workspace_handle
        - task_payload
      properties:
        workspace_handle:
          type: string
        task_payload:
          type: object
          description: 业务输入载荷，文本/文件引用/结构化参数
        enable_drift_monitor:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 开启漂移退化分数计算
        require_archive:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 任务完成后执行归档锁档
    TaskSubmitResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        task_id:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [running, queued]
        task_accept_timestamp:
          type: integer
          format: int64
    TaskResultResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        task_id:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [completed,failed,running]
        final_truth_output:
          type: object
          description: 经过全局仲裁层校验后的候选真值，不包含原始推演草稿
        audit_credential:
          type: object
          properties:
            merkle_root:
              type: string
            task_t_chain_id:
              type: string
            snap_sha256:
              type: string
            domain_type:
              type: string
            drift_degenerate_score:
              type: number
              description: 漂移退化分数，0‑1，数值越高漂移风险越大
        draft_access_token:
          type: string
          description: 高权限Token，凭此才可拉取草稿；普通调用方为空
    DraftFetchRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - task_id
        - draft_access_token
      properties:
        task_id:
          type: string
        draft_access_token:
          type: string
    CredentialVerifyRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - merkle_root
        - task_t_chain_id
      properties:
        merkle_root:
          type: string
        task_t_chain_id:
          type: string
    CredentialVerifyResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        valid:
          type: boolean
        credential_meta:
          type: object
          description: 凭证元信息，不返回原始大体积业务数据
    WorkspaceArchiveRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - workspace_handle
      properties:
        workspace_handle:
          type: string
        archive_mode:
          type: string
          enum: [cold_base85, snapshot_only]
          default: cold_base85
    WorkspaceArchiveResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        credential_id:
          type: string
          description: 全局归档凭证ID
    ParadigmRegisterRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - paradigm_content
        - paradigm_signature
      properties:
        paradigm_content:
          type: object
          description: 业务范式内容（模板、评估指标），仅允许业务扩展，禁止修改底层五元元法则
        paradigm_signature:
          type: string
          description: 范式签名校验
    ParadigmRegisterResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
        paradigm_id:
          type: string
paths:
  /meta/workspace/fork:
    post:
      tags:
        - Workspace管理
      summary: Fork全新隔离Workspace实例，基于ZONGYUAN‑ROOT根快照
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceForkRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceForkResponse'
  /meta/task/submit:
    post:
      tags:
        - 任务推演
      summary: 向Workspace提交推演任务，完整执行Ω‑Brainμ流水线
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskSubmitRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 任务已接收进入队列
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskSubmitResponse'
  /meta/task/result:
    get:
      tags:
        - 任务推演
      summary: 查询任务结果，返回仲裁后真值与审计凭证，默认不返回草稿
      parameters:
        - name: task_id
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 任务结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskResultResponse'
  /meta/task/draft:
    get:
      tags:
        - 任务推演
      summary: 高权限接口：按需拉取内部推演草稿，需要draft_access_token
      parameters:
        - name: task_id
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: draft_access_token
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 返回草稿集合
  /meta/credential/verify:
    post:
      tags:
        - 凭证核验
      summary: 凭证校验，核验Merkle根与T‑链是否合法有效
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CredentialVerifyRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 凭证校验结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CredentialVerifyResponse'
  /meta/workspace/archive:
    post:
      tags:
        - Workspace管理
      summary: Workspace执行全域锁档归档，BASE85冷归档
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceArchiveRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 归档完成返回全局凭证ID
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceArchiveResponse'
  /meta/paradigm/register:
    post:
      tags:
        - 范式管理
      summary: 注册业务扩展范式，不可修改底层元法则
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ParadigmRegisterRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 范式注册完成
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ParadigmRegisterResponse'
```

## 使用说明

1. 将完整 YAML 复制保存为 `meta‑eternal‑openapi‑v1.yaml`，可直接导入 Apifox / Postman / FastAPI Swagger。
2. HTTP Header 鉴权字段：`X‑Meta‑Auth‑Key: ${API_KEY}`。
3. gRPC 版本：在此 OpenAPI 基础上转换 Protobuf，适合图片、文档大载荷传输。
4. 网关层实现要点：

   - 拦截所有尝试修改 ZONGYUAN‑ROOT 根节点的请求；
   - 草稿接口必须校验`draft_access_token`；
   - 每个响应返回的审计凭证可以脱离服务端做本地哈希校验。

> 全域锁档归档：快照 SNAP‑OPENAPI‑001，写入 Merkle 谱系挂载 ZONGYUAN‑ROOT，DID‑BR‑000002。
